Services

What we do for your business

From a simple page to a site with a quote tool or store. Choose only what you need.

  • Websites

    Clear, fast pages that present your business and bring you client messages.

    • Up to 6 pages: home, services, about, contact
    • Mobile, tablet and desktop ready
    • Fast loading and basic SEO setup

    Ideal for: small businesses and independent professionals

  • Online stores

    Product catalog and orders so you can sell from your site.

    • Product catalog with photos, variants and stock
    • Cart, checkout and order tracking
    • Payment by card, PayPal or Bitcoin

    Ideal for: shops, brands and local stores

  • Quotes and bookings

    Forms that calculate prices or receive requests by WhatsApp.

    • Price calculator for quotes by service
    • Booking form with date and time picker
    • Requests sent straight to WhatsApp or email

    Ideal for: services, clinics, studios and contractors

  • Social media marketing

    Consistent content and posts so your brand looks professional.

    • Monthly content calendar
    • Designs for posts, stories and banners
    • Captions written for your audience

    Ideal for: brands that want steady visibility

  • Google and local SEO

    Google Business profile and improvements so people find you in your area.

    • Google Business Profile setup and optimization
    • Local keywords and page optimization
    • Review and listing monitoring

    Ideal for: businesses that serve a city or region

  • Visual identity

    Logo, colors and typefaces so your business looks consistent.

    • Logo design and variations
    • Color palette and typography system
    • Brand guide for web, print and social

    Ideal for: new businesses and rebrands
